def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row},
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))

    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                # Only process the first cell of each same-color diagonal run.
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue

                # Extend upward along the diagonal; if obstructed, extend the
                # other end in the opposite direction.
                r0, c0 = run[0]
                ar, ac = r0 - dr, c0 - dc
                if 0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and grid[ar][ac] != bg:
                    r0, c0 = run[-1]
                    sr, sc = dr, dc
                else:
                    sr, sc = -dr, -dc

                rr, cc = r0 + sr, c0 + sc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc
    return out
